import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy import stats

# Load the data
conn = sqlite3.connect('customer360.db')
df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM customer360__customer_value_analysis", conn)
conn.close()

# Set display options for better readability
pd.set_option('display.max_columns', None)
pd.set_option('display.width', None)

print("Dataset shape:", df.shape)
print("\nDataset info:")
print(df.info())
print("\nFirst 5 rows:")
print(df.head())

# Separate numeric and categorical columns
numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
categorical_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['object', 'category']).columns.tolist()

print(f"\nNumeric columns ({len(numeric_cols)}): {numeric_cols}")
print(f"Categorical columns ({len(categorical_cols)}): {categorical_cols}")

# Initialize profiling results dictionary
profiling_results = {}

# Profile numeric columns
print("\n" + "="*80)
print("NUMERIC COLUMNS PROFILING")
print("="*80)

for col in numeric_cols:
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Column: {col}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    
    # Basic statistics
    stats_dict = {
        'count': df[col].count(),
        'missing': df[col].isnull().sum(),
        'missing_pct': (df[col].isnull().sum() / len(df)) * 100,
        'mean': df[col].mean(),
        'std': df[col].std(),
        'min': df[col].min(),
        '25%': df[col].quantile(0.25),
        '50%': df[col].quantile(0.50),
        '75%': df[col].quantile(0.75),
        'max': df[col].max(),
        'range': df[col].max() - df[col].min(),
        'iqr': df[col].quantile(0.75) - df[col].quantile(0.25),
        'skewness': df[col].skew(),
        'kurtosis': df[col].kurtosis(),
        'zeros': (df[col] == 0).sum(),
        'zeros_pct': ((df[col] == 0).sum() / len(df)) * 100
    }
    
    # Store in profiling results
    profiling_results[col] = {
        'type': 'numeric',
        'stats': stats_dict,
        'unique_values': df[col].nunique(),
        'unique_pct': (df[col].nunique() / len(df)) * 100
    }
    
    # Print statistics
    stats_df = pd.DataFrame([stats_dict])
    print("Basic Statistics:")
    print(stats_df.T.to_string(header=False))
    
    # Print unique values info
    print(f"\nUnique values: {df[col].nunique()} ({profiling_results[col]['unique_pct']:.2f}%)")
    
    # Detect potential outliers using IQR method
    Q1 = stats_dict['25%']
    Q3 = stats_dict['75%']
    IQR = stats_dict['iqr']
    lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
    upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
    outliers = df[(df[col] < lower_bound) | (df[col] > upper_bound)][col]
    
    print(f"Potential outliers (IQR method): {len(outliers)} ({len(outliers)/len(df)*100:.2f}%)")
    if len(outliers) > 0:
        print(f"Outlier range: [{outliers.min():.2f}, {outliers.max():.2f}]")
    
    # Value distribution (top 10 values)
    print(f"\nTop 10 most frequent values:")
    value_counts = df[col].value_counts().head(10)
    for val, count in value_counts.items():
        pct = (count / len(df)) * 100
        print(f"  {val}: {count} ({pct:.2f}%)")

# Profile categorical columns
print("\n" + "="*80)
print("CATEGORICAL COLUMNS PROFILING")
print("="*80)

for col in categorical_cols:
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Column: {col}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    
    # Basic statistics
    stats_dict = {
        'count': df[col].count(),
        'missing': df[col].isnull().sum(),
        'missing_pct': (df[col].isnull().sum() / len(df)) * 100,
        'unique': df[col].nunique(),
        'unique_pct': (df[col].nunique() / len(df)) * 100,
        'mode': df[col].mode().iloc[0] if not df[col].mode().empty else np.nan,
        'mode_freq': df[col].value_counts().iloc[0] if not df[col].value_counts().empty else 0,
        'mode_pct': (df[col].value_counts().iloc[0] / len(df) * 100) if not df[col].value_counts().empty else 0
    }
    
    # Store in profiling results
    profiling_results[col] = {
        'type': 'categorical',
        'stats': stats_dict
    }
    
    # Print statistics
    stats_df = pd.DataFrame([stats_dict])
    print("Basic Statistics:")
    print(stats_df.T.to_string(header=False))
    
    # Value distribution
    print(f"\nValue distribution (top 20):")
    value_counts = df[col].value_counts().head(20)
    total_count = value_counts.sum()
    
    for i, (val, count) in enumerate(value_counts.items(), 1):
        pct = (count / len(df)) * 100
        cum_pct = (value_counts.iloc[:i].sum() / len(df)) * 100
        print(f"  {i:2d}. {str(val)[:50]:50s} {count:6d} ({pct:6.2f}%) [Cum: {cum_pct:6.2f}%]")
    
    # Check for long tail
    if len(value_counts) > 20:
        remaining = df[col].value_counts().iloc[20:].sum()
        remaining_pct = (remaining / len(df)) * 100
        print(f"  ... and {len(df[col].value_counts()) - 20} more values: {remaining} ({remaining_pct:.2f}%)")

# Summary statistics
print("\n" + "="*80)
print("DATASET SUMMARY")
print("="*80)

print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Total columns: {len(df.columns)}")
print(f"Numeric columns: {len(numeric_cols)}")
print(f"Categorical columns: {len(categorical_cols)}")

# Missing values summary
missing_summary = df.isnull().sum()
missing_cols = missing_summary[missing_summary > 0]
if len(missing_cols) > 0:
    print(f"\nColumns with missing values ({len(missing_cols)}):")
    for col, count in missing_cols.items():
        pct = (count / len(df)) * 100
        print(f"  {col}: {count} ({pct:.2f}%)")
else:
    print("\nNo missing values found in any column.")

# Save profiling results to a structured format
profiling_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'column': list(profiling_results.keys()),
    'type': [profiling_results[col]['type'] for col in profiling_results.keys()],
    'unique_values': [profiling_results[col].get('unique_values', np.nan) 
                     if profiling_results[col]['type'] == 'numeric' 
                     else profiling_results[col]['stats']['unique'] 
                     for col in profiling_results.keys()],
    'missing_pct': [profiling_results[col]['stats']['missing_pct'] 
                   for col in profiling_results.keys()],
    'description': [f"{profiling_results[col]['type'].capitalize()} column with " +
                   f"{profiling_results[col].get('unique_values', profiling_results[col]['stats']['unique'])} " +
                   f"unique values and {profiling_results[col]['stats']['missing_pct']:.1f}% missing"
                   for col in profiling_results.keys()]
})

print("\nProfiling summary saved to 'profiling_results' variable")
print("Use 'profiling_df' for a structured overview of all columns")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy import stats

# Load the data
conn = sqlite3.connect('customer360.db')
df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM customer360__customer_value_analysis", conn)
conn.close()

# Set display options for better readability
pd.set_option('display.max_columns', None)
pd.set_option('display.width', None)

print("Dataset shape:", df.shape)
print("\nDataset info:")
print(df.info())
print("\nFirst 5 rows:")
print(df.head())

# Separate numeric and categorical columns
numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
categorical_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['object', 'category']).columns.tolist()

print(f"\nNumeric columns ({len(numeric_cols)}): {numeric_cols}")
print(f"Categorical columns ({len(categorical_cols)}): {categorical_cols}")

# Initialize profiling results dictionary
profiling_results = {}

# Profile numeric columns
print("\n" + "="*80)
print("NUMERIC COLUMNS PROFILING")
print("="*80)

for col in numeric_cols:
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Column: {col}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    
    # Basic statistics
    stats_dict = {
        'count': df[col].count(),
        'missing': df[col].isnull().sum(),
        'missing_pct': (df[col].isnull().sum() / len(df)) * 100,
        'mean': df[col].mean(),
        'std': df[col].std(),
        'min': df[col].min(),
        '25%': df[col].quantile(0.25),
        '50%': df[col].quantile(0.50),
        '75%': df[col].quantile(0.75),
        'max': df[col].max(),
        'range': df[col].max() - df[col].min(),
        'iqr': df[col].quantile(0.75) - df[col].quantile(0.25),
        'skewness': df[col].skew(),
        'kurtosis': df[col].kurtosis(),
        'zeros': (df[col] == 0).sum(),
        'zeros_pct': ((df[col] == 0).sum() / len(df)) * 100
    }
    
    # Store in profiling results
    profiling_results[col] = {
        'type': 'numeric',
        'stats': stats_dict,
        'unique_values': df[col].nunique(),
        'unique_pct': (df[col].nunique() / len(df)) * 100
    }
    
    # Print statistics
    stats_df = pd.DataFrame([stats_dict])
    print("Basic Statistics:")
    print(stats_df.T.to_string(header=False))
    
    # Print unique values info
    print(f"\nUnique values: {df[col].nunique()} ({profiling_results[col]['unique_pct']:.2f}%)")
    
    # Detect potential outliers using IQR method
    Q1 = stats_dict['25%']
    Q3 = stats_dict['75%']
    IQR = stats_dict['iqr']
    lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
    upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
    outliers = df[(df[col] < lower_bound) | (df[col] > upper_bound)][col]
    
    print(f"Potential outliers (IQR method): {len(outliers)} ({len(outliers)/len(df)*100:.2f}%)")
    if len(outliers) > 0:
        print(f"Outlier range: [{outliers.min():.2f}, {outliers.max():.2f}]")
    
    # Value distribution (top 10 values)
    print(f"\nTop 10 most frequent values:")
    value_counts = df[col].value_counts().head(10)
    for val, count in value_counts.items():
        pct = (count / len(df)) * 100
        print(f"  {val}: {count} ({pct:.2f}%)")

# Profile categorical columns
print("\n" + "="*80)
print("CATEGORICAL COLUMNS PROFILING")
print("="*80)

for col in categorical_cols:
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Column: {col}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    
    # Basic statistics
    stats_dict = {
        'count': df[col].count(),
        'missing': df[col].isnull().sum(),
        'missing_pct': (df[col].isnull().sum() / len(df)) * 100,
        'unique': df[col].nunique(),
        'unique_pct': (df[col].nunique() / len(df)) * 100,
        'mode': df[col].mode().iloc[0] if not df[col].mode().empty else np.nan,
        'mode_freq': df[col].value_counts().iloc[0] if not df[col].value_counts().empty else 0,
        'mode_pct': (df[col].value_counts().iloc[0] / len(df) * 100) if not df[col].value_counts().empty else 0
    }
    
    # Store in profiling results
    profiling_results[col] = {
        'type': 'categorical',
        'stats': stats_dict
    }
    
    # Print statistics
    stats_df = pd.DataFrame([stats_dict])
    print("Basic Statistics:")
    print(stats_df.T.to_string(header=False))
    
    # Value distribution
    print(f"\nValue distribution (top 20):")
    value_counts = df[col].value_counts().head(20)
    total_count = value_counts.sum()
    
    for i, (val, count) in enumerate(value_counts.items(), 1):
        pct = (count / len(df)) * 100
        cum_pct = (value_counts.iloc[:i].sum() / len(df)) * 100
        print(f"  {i:2d}. {str(val)[:50]:50s} {count:6d} ({pct:6.2f}%) [Cum: {cum_pct:6.2f}%]")
    
    # Check for long tail
    if len(value_counts) > 20:
        remaining = df[col].value_counts().iloc[20:].sum()
        remaining_pct = (remaining / len(df)) * 100
        print(f"  ... and {len(df[col].value_counts()) - 20} more values: {remaining} ({remaining_pct:.2f}%)")

# Summary statistics
print("\n" + "="*80)
print("DATASET SUMMARY")
print("="*80)

print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Total columns: {len(df.columns)}")
print(f"Numeric columns: {len(numeric_cols)}")
print(f"Categorical columns: {len(categorical_cols)}")

# Missing values summary
missing_summary = df.isnull().sum()
missing_cols = missing_summary[missing_summary > 0]
if len(missing_cols) > 0:
    print(f"\nColumns with missing values ({len(missing_cols)}):")
    for col, count in missing_cols.items():
        pct = (count / len(df)) * 100
        print(f"  {col}: {count} ({pct:.2f}%)")
else:
    print("\nNo missing values found in any column.")

# Save profiling results to a structured format
profiling_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'column': list(profiling_results.keys()),
    'type': [profiling_results[col]['type'] for col in profiling_results.keys()],
    'unique_values': [profiling_results[col].get('unique_values', np.nan) 
                     if profiling_results[col]['type'] == 'numeric' 
                     else profiling_results[col]['stats']['unique'] 
                     for col in profiling_results.keys()],
    'missing_pct': [profiling_results[col]['stats']['missing_pct'] 
                   for col in profiling_results.keys()],
    'description': [f"{profiling_results[col]['type'].capitalize()} column with " +
                   f"{profiling_results[col].get('unique_values', profiling_results[col]['stats']['unique'])} " +
                   f"unique values and {profiling_results[col]['stats']['missing_pct']:.1f}% missing"
                   for col in profiling_results.keys()]
})

print("\nProfiling summary saved to 'profiling_results' variable")
print("Use 'profiling_df' for a structured overview of all columns")
